# About Infinite Spaces

> Every space has a world inside it. Infinite Spaces is the platform that wakes them up — creatives author living worlds in Playbox and run them live in venues, streams, and homes. This community is where those worlds, and the people who build them, find each other.

## Real places, brought alive
For fifty years the screen pulled us out of the room. We build the thing that pulls the world back in: every screen, light, speaker, and camera in a space joined into one instrument that plays with the people in it.

## Yours by default
A world you build is your own — its own database, in your own region — to self-host, move, hand off, or archive. Open and interoperable, and the data your world generates belongs to you.

## Agents as collaborators
People and agents build together. Agents hold roles and build in parallel — they do the work that scales, so creatives can do the work that doesn't.
